audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits: Sylas wins the melee brawl at most stages but Talon's first-item lethality spike and roam threat carry high punish potential; side lane and fog picks are his game, teamfights are Sylas's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart disagrees with content and packet on all seven rows: full has Talon 1-4/5 and Skill 6+, content win[] and packet both say Sylas everywhere except First item (Talon).
audit.why: Layers must agree; content whys are grounded (Talon must enter melee Q range pre-item; his lethality first-item spike is his one window).
audit.corrected: phases[0-4].side -> Sylas, phases[5].side -> Talon with rewritten why, phases[6].side -> Sylas; ratings 0-3 softened from 8/7 to 6 to reflect a moderate edge, not a stomp.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and the content mid section call Talon's E 'Cutthroat' — that ability was removed in his rework; his E is Assassin's Path, a terrain vault with no engage. Also: no digits in breakdown.cooldowns, two copy-paste bleeds. Kit derived flag marks Rake as 'knockup' — Riot's text describes daggers plus a slow, no displacement; treated as a parse misfire and not written.
audit.why: Kit file is authority: Q Noxian Diplomacy 8s (refunds health/cooldown on kill only), W Rake 9s with the return dealing the bonus damage, E Assassin's Path terrain vault, R Shadow Assault 100/80/60 vs Hijack 80/55/30.
audit.corrected: 'Cutthroat' replaced with the real engage threat (his Q leap) in both places; cooldowns rewritten with numbers; bleeds replaced with grounded advice.

edits.before: Talon wins by landing Rake, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Talon wins by stacking three Wounds with Rake and Q, then one-comboing you the moment you sit chunked or step up low.

edits.before: Q-poke the wave contacts — the chain detonation chips while you wait for the real kit at 3.
edits.after: He must walk into melee Q range to trade — your Q chains chip him for free on every wave contact.

edits.before: First item spike: full chains with a stolen ult delete or out-brawl anything mid offers.
edits.after: His lethality first item plus Shadow Assault one-combos you if chunked — his window, respect it.

edits.before: - Talon Rake: matchup-defining — The boomerang return is most of his lane damage — stand off the return line. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Abscond (shield-dash) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Rake is 9s at rank 1 and the return is most of his lane damage — stand off the line, step up in its downtime. - His Q is 8s and refunds only on kill. - Budget your 13s E for his leap and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: His Q refunds cooldown and health only on kill — deny the reset and his 8s Q stays down while your chains land.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: Open with E Abscond before his combo lands, not after — a reactive dash mid-Rake eats the return daggers and the slow.

edits.before: You out-brawl him here — your Kingslayer sustain and Petricite Burst shields beat his burst if you're not already low. Bait his Cutthroat (E) engage, and remember you can Hijack an enemy ultimate for extra teamfight presence; just don't get caught full-combo from fog.
edits.after: You out-brawl him here — your Kingslayer sustain and Petricite Burst shields beat his burst if you're not already low. Bait his Noxian Diplomacy leap, and remember you can Hijack an enemy ultimate for extra teamfight presence; just don't get caught full-combo from fog.

edits.before: Through 5-6 you stay ahead in a fair brawl — your Kingslayer sustain and Petricite shielding beat his front-loaded burst as long as you aren't already chunked. Bait his Cutthroat engage, punish his Rake cooldowns, and use your own R Hijack for teamfight presence. Just respect that a Talon who catches you low from fog can still combo you.
edits.after: Through 5-6 you stay ahead in a fair brawl — your Kingslayer sustain and Petricite shielding beat his front-loaded burst as long as you aren't already chunked. Bait his Noxian Diplomacy leap, punish his Rake cooldowns, and use your own R Hijack for teamfight presence. Just respect that a Talon who catches you low from fog can still combo you.

notes: 'Cutthroat' is Talon's pre-rework E and no longer exists — replaced with his real gap-closer (Noxian Diplomacy leap) in spikes[1].text and content mid. Kit derived flag marks Rake as 'knockup'; Riot's text describes daggers and a slow only — parse misfire, not written to the page. Full-layer chart was inverted against both content win[] and the packet on every row; moved to match (win[] already correct, side-only edits per the chart rule; row 0 and row 5 got rewritten whys, rows 1-3 whys already describe the Sylas brawl plan and rows 4/6 describe Sylas winning). Ratings on rows 0-3 softened 8/7 -> 6. Templated but not grounded further: ahead, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.carry, breakdown.late, loading, tldr, winCon. sectionsMissing: those ten fields. Page-wide 'E-shield / Petricite shields' language: Riot's kit text for Sylas P and E mentions no shield; likely stale from an older Sylas version, but present across every matchup — flagged for a champion-level decision rather than edited piecemeal here.
